samples.query: WITH r AS (SELECT instance, seed, started_ms, lead(started_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY instance ORDER BY started_ms) AS until_ms FROM runs), s AS (SELECT x.instance, r.seed, r.started_ms AS run_ms, x.ts_ms, x.game_tick, x.game_date, x.value, x.money, x.loan, x.net, x.vehicles FROM samples x JOIN r ON r.instance = x.instance AND x.ts_ms >= r.started_ms AND (r.until_ms IS NULL OR x.ts_ms < r.until_ms) WHERE x.company = 1 QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x.instance, r.started_ms, substr(x.game_date, 1, 7) ORDER BY x.game_tick, x.ts_ms) = 1), a AS (SELECT e.instance, r.started_ms AS run_ms, e.ts_ms, TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(e.data, '$.choice.settings.aggressiveness') AS BIGINT) AS aggressiveness, json_extract_string(e.data, '$.choice.outcome') AS directive_outcome FROM events e JOIN r ON r.instance = e.instance AND e.ts_ms >= r.started_ms AND (r.until_ms IS NULL OR e.ts_ms < r.until_ms) WHERE e.kind = 'plan.directive' AND json_extract_string(e.data, '$.choice.outcome') IN ('applied', 'pending', 'unverified', 'sent') AND TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(e.data, '$.choice.company_id') AS BIGINT) = 1 AND json_extract_string(e.data, '$.choice.settings.aggressiveness') IS NOT NULL) SELECT s.instance, s.seed, s.run_ms, s.game_tick, s.game_date, s.value, s.money, s.loan, s.net, s.vehicles, a.aggressiveness, a.directive_outcome FROM s ASOF LEFT JOIN a ON s.instance = a.instance AND s.run_ms = a.run_ms AND s.ts_ms >= a.ts_ms ORDER BY s.instance, s.run_ms, s.game_tick
